brief: Little hexagon pieces that snap together and pull apart, for my nine-month-old to play with on the floor.

requirements.evidence: 3x piece:0,0,0;full, piece:0,1,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full joined wall-to-wall by 3x side-connector-single (connector:0#0,0|0,1 etc); get_build shows 3 separate groups joined by connectors, check_build meshClash clear; lockJoints intentionally omitted so joints can be pulled apart, leaving expected LOOSE_BODY warning
requirements.requirement: Hexagon pieces that snap together and pull apart

requirements.evidence: 3 full hex bases with full top covers + 12 end caps; footprint 364x384mm, 80mm tall; full bases are ~190mm across, not tiny finger-size pieces

Parts are 3D-printed in user-chosen material; configurator verifies fit/collisions only and knows nothing about material safety, strength, choking, mouthing, or infant-toy certification. Single side-connectors are small separable parts. No claim of mouth-safe, non-toxic, load or bite-safe can be made.
requirements.requirement: Safe for a nine-month-old to play with

finish.summary: Small 3-hex cluster joined by separable single side-connectors so pieces snap together and pull apart; tops closed with covers and open faces capped, lockJoints left off to preserve pull-apart play. Mesh clear. NOT verified safe for a 9-month-old: material/strength/choking safety is outside what the configurator checks — do not give to an infant without certified infant-toy review.

lines.label: pvc-section-single (cut 9 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))

cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes

events.text: Got it — small, pull-apart pieces for floor play. I'm checking how these hexes connect.

result.note: A joint bolt fastens the wall between two touching bases. No place on the build takes this part right now. Change the build so it can (for example add the cells it needs beside or below it), then ask again. Guessing raw ops for a part with no offers rarely works.

A side connector joins two bases that stand side by side on the same storey. Bases that touch with no connector on the wall between them are one body (joint bolts); every wall between two groups needs a connector, walls inside a group stay bare. get_build lists each touching wall and the groups.
